create_inventory_component: create an Inventory component to track player items with ItemTypeConfig and initial endowments
configure_item_type: configure an ItemTypeConfig with name, minimum, maximum bounds, and force_integer validation
update_inventory_with_function: apply a callable function to update all player inventories using the apply method
get_player_inventory: get a player's current inventory as a mapping of item types to quantities
score_players_by_inventory: create a Score component to calculate player scores based on target items in their inventory
